author: Monty
interpretation: Named written history units with scoped decisions and controls; not counts of sutras, executed cases or complete paradigm cells.

histories.title: Added suffix after the same enabling deletion
histories.outcome_scope: Seven shared and seven added-affix-policy stages to the same unaccented feminine stem, preserving separate base-अन् and suffix-इ deletion events.
histories.notes: The complete licensed addition path shares prior टि-lopa and its admission gate. N/P4.1.78's इञ्-intervention and 1.1.57 argument is retained as a consumer-qualified local comparison, not as a second cause of an already-completed deletion or an early-ष्यङ् license.

histories.title: टि names the complete final अन्
histories.outcome_scope: Correct final-अन् target; blocked न्-only span and suffix-owner targets for the fixed 6.4.144 event.
histories.notes: A later coincidentally convergent string does not validate a wrong event address. This control adds no inflectional position and is not executed.

histories.title: The relevant heavy syllable must actually be penultimate
histories.outcome_scope: False weight gate before टि-lopa and true weight gate after it, with remaining lexical/semantic premises supplied separately.
histories.notes: Deletion changes the penultimate vowel position from short अ to the already-long ओ; there is no अ-to-ओ lengthening. Premature ष्यङ् admission remains blocked.

histories.title: Preservation conditions are checked against the actual suffix
histories.outcome_scope: Initial इञ् does not meet either preservation suffix condition; separate अण् and non-भाव/कर्म य-initial supplied domains remain admitted.
histories.notes: The unwanted औडुलोमन्या is a forced early-य diagnostic already blocked at 4.1.78, not another legal output or a blanket priority claim.

histories.title: Added ष्यङ् has a separate intervening इ witness
histories.outcome_scope: Source-qualified added-affix intervention view after इ deletion; blocked import of that witness into the replacement policy; missing policy/event evidence remains Open.
histories.notes: Both complete legal paths share earlier enabling टि-lopa. The later deleted-इ witness is a separately qualified consumer comparison, not that deletion's cause and not a current preservation event on an absent अन् target.

histories.title: Retained history is not an unrestricted restoration instruction
histories.outcome_scope: Local commentary-ordered construction accepted; unsupported global historical rollback rejected; every broader late-168/asiddhavat scheduling claim remains Open.
histories.notes: No universal non-reapplication rule is inferred. A historical consumer requires its own cause/domain qualification; same word or suffix identity alone does not prove समानाश्रयत्व.

histories.title: लोमन् membership does not infer every compound's admission
histories.outcome_scope: Named उडुलोमन् compound/descent admission with independent feminine, non-ऋषि, गोत्र and weight premises; missing premise remains Open and contrary premise blocks that prescription.
histories.notes: The coherent ड-family spelling is adopted from explicit primary witnesses; K4.1.96's औङुलोमिः is retained literally, without an invented ङ-to-ड sound rule.

histories.title: Replacement after its enabling टि deletion
histories.outcome_scope: Seven shared and six replacement-policy stages to the unaccented feminine stem औडुलोम्या; a rejected four-stage premature-substitution diagnostic is separately labelled.
histories.notes: Before base-अन् deletion the penultimate ma is light; after deletion the pre-existing long ओ in lo becomes penultimate. Replacement is admitted only after this dependency is satisfied. The source's local आनुपूर्व्य solution does not establish a universal later-168 or asiddhavat scheduler.
